[CONTRIBUTION EVENT]
- Type: Time (Minutes)
- Amount: 45
- Description: Diagnosed and fixed two independent issues in the TrueSight DAO tokenomics GAS pipeline.
                                                                                                                                    
    1. Multi-item Stripe checkout → Agroverse QR code linkage                                                                       
       - Root cause: `Stripe Social Media Checkout ID` column P can only hold one QR code per session row, so multi-item purchases  
    (e.g., Telegram rows 8093–8097, one session with 5 QR codes) lost their Stripe linkage.                                         
       - Fix: introduced column Z (`Stripe Session ID`) on `Agroverse QR codes` as the primary FK. Each QR row now independently
    records its source session. Column P kept as legacy fallback.                                                                   
       - `process_qr_code_updates.gs`: writes column Z on `[QR CODE UPDATE EVENT]`; stops touching column J of `Telegram Chat Logs`
    (owned by TDG scoring); added `patchStripeDataForTelegramRows8093To8097` to backfill the 5 affected rows.                       
       - `qr_code_web_service.gs`: `lookupStripeCheckoutByQrCode_` and `listUnassignedStripeSessions_` now prefer column Z with
    column P fallback.                                                                                                              
       - Documented column Z in `SCHEMA.md` and `agentic_ai_context/NOTES_tokenomics.md`.
       - PR: https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/tokenomics/pull/226 (merged)                                                           
                                                                                                                                    
    2. 30-minute trigger timeouts on two Telegram-log processors                                                                    
       - `grok_scoring_for_telegram_and_whatsapp_logs.gs` (contributions scoring):                                                  
         * Replaced hardcoded `IGNORE_BEFORE_DATE` with a dynamic cutoff set to the equinox/solstice two events before the most     
    recent past event (~6-month rolling window, auto-advances).                                                                     
         * Column J state machine: `"Pending"` → `"Full Provision Awarded"` when records are scored, `"Successfully Completed"`     
    otherwise. Added one-time backfill pass for previously-processed rows, then made column J the primary filter in                 
    `processTelegramChatLogs` so subsequent runs skip non-Pending rows in a single cell read.
       - `tdg_expenses_processing.gs` (expenses scoring, live deployment `1Q5HfGR…`):                                               
         * Reordered `parseAndProcessTelegramLogs` so the `[DAO Inventory Expense Event]` pattern check short-circuits >99% of rows 
    before any parsing or logging. Removed per-row `Logger.log` calls that were the main time sink. hashKey dedup moved earlier in  
    the loop.                                                                                                                       
                                                                                                                                    
    Scope: GAS canonical source in `tokenomics/`, clasp mirrors for `1UrBgqLnnQc…`, `1slQVojn…`, `1BHAGZd…`, `1Q5HfGR…` pushed and  
    deployed where needed. `SCHEMA.md` and `agentic_ai_context/NOTES_tokenomics.md` updated so future work knows about column Z
    primacy and column J ownership by the TDG scoring script.
- Contributor(s): Gary Teh
- TDG Issued: 75.00
- Attached Filename: None (proof: links in description)
- Destination Contribution File Location: See description (URL(s))
